This [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed '''lightsaber''' was created by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Yun]]. The weapon came equipped with a so-called "modified pistol grip" meaning that carefully cast projections echoed the [[Human/Legends|Human]] hand and gave his index finger a place to rest. Not only that, but the grip was made from a highly malleable "live" [[Polymer/Legends|polymer]] that explored the user's hand and morphed into a solid, highly customized grip.<ref name="Jedi Knight" />

[[File:Rahn_fighting.jpg|left|200px|thumb|Rahn makes his last stand with Yun's lightsaber]]
After being brought aboard [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] flagship, the [[Vengeance (Vengeance-class)|''Vengeance'']], Qu Rahn stole it and briefly used it to defend himself against [[Seven Dark Jedi|Jerec's Dark Jedi]], only managing to bisect [[Maw (Dark Jedi)|Maw]] before being subdued by Jerec. Yun used it in his [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with [[Kyle Katarn]], taking it with him when fleeing from the aspiring Jedi. When [[Sariss]] tried to kill Katarn after his crash on [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]], Yun then used it to prevent her from doing so, leading to his [[Death/Legends|death]]. After that, Kyle Katarn used it to duel and kill Sariss, [[Boc Aseca]] and Jerec. He also used it prior to and during his fall to [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|the dark side]].<ref name="Jedi Knight" />

[[File:Training.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Katarn using Yun's saber, now with an orange crystal.]]

Following his brush with the dark side of the Force, Katarn stopped using this lightsaber and instead built [[Kyle Katarn's third lightsaber|his own lightsaber]].<ref name="Jedi Outcast" />
